name: Wink
overview: The Bible presents winking as a gesture associated with deceit, malice, and secretive wrongdoing. In Job 15:12, winking is linked to a heart led astray and eyes that overlook sin, while Psalm 35:19 condemns those who wink in hatred without cause. Proverbs highlights the craftiness of the wicked who wink with their eyes to communicate hidden intentions, causing sorrow and leading to downfall (Proverbs 6:13; 10:10). Thus, Scripture warns against using such subtle signals to promote wickedness or harm others.
